Investors are also focused on a potential new shareholder return policy announcement alongside the results, given the company's record profitability from HBM4 AI memory chips.
key_facts: Wall Street consensus shows ~86% upside to SKHY
SK Hynix Q3 reports October 28
New shareholder return policy possible alongside results
HBM4 ramp driving record margins
SK Hynix made Nasdaq debut July 10 raising ~$29B
Q2 2026 operating profit 60.54T won missed 64T estimate

headline: Asian stocks advance Oct 27 following Wall Street rally and oil price decline
summary: Asian stocks advanced on Tuesday October 27 following Monday's Wall Street gains driven by Anthropic's IPO filing and lower oil prices. Global shares were mixed overall as investors awaited central bank rate decisions including the US Federal Reserve and weighed the heavy earnings calendar. Oil prices retreated modestly from recent highs.

Anthropic IPO filing and oil decline drove Oct 26 US gains
Global shares mixed ahead of Fed and other central bank decisions
Heavy Q3 earnings calendar adds to market uncertainty
Oil prices modestly lower on Oman-Iran diplomacy signal

summary: Investor attention ahead of Samsung Electronics' and SK Hynix's Q3 2026 earnings is focused on shareholder return announcements. Both companies are expected to release results within days.

SK Hynix could announce special dividend with Q3 results Oct 28

headline: Barclays: SpaceX-Tesla merger announcement could come before December; SpaceX likely acquirer
summary: Barclays analyst Dan Levy issued a note saying a Tesla-SpaceX merger announcement could come before December 2026, ahead of Tesla's annual shareholder meeting. Levy sees SpaceX as the likely acquirer in an all-stock deal and noted that Musk's 48% stake in SpaceX with 82% voting power simplifies the deal structure from SpaceX's perspective.

SpaceX likely acquirer in all-stock structure
Musk owns ~48% of SpaceX with ~82% voting power
Tesla annual meeting is a natural catalyst window
Musk recused from committee deliberations
JPMorgan flagged China regulatory approval as hurdle

headline: UPS Q2 2026: revenue $22.83B +7.6% YoY; raised FY 2026 outlook to $91.2B, $7.22 EPS
summary: UPS reported Q2 2026 consolidated revenue of $22.83 billion, up 7.6% year over year, with non-GAAP EPS of $1.76. The company raised its full-year 2026 guidance to revenue of approximately $91.2 billion, non-GAAP operating profit of $8.65 billion, and non-GAAP EPS of $7.22. Management cited entering the second half with strong momentum, supporting the upward revision.

headline: Iran attacks 10 ships near Hormuz in retaliation for US strikes destroying 5 Iranian tankers
summary: Iran said it attacked 10 ships near the Strait of Hormuz in retaliation for US strikes that destroyed five Iranian oil tankers, intensifying the confrontation across Gulf shipping routes. The escalation pushed Brent crude above $100 per barrel for the first time since July 2026, according to the report. Trump disputed Iran's attack claims, saying Iran was 'making up fake hits, mines, and everything else' to push oil prices higher.
key_facts: Iran claimed attacking 10 ships near Hormuz
Retaliation for US strikes destroying 5 Iranian oil tankers
Brent surged above $100 on the escalation
Trump disputed Iran attack claims
UK UKMTO recorded 24+ attacks in October (record)
Conflict began after US/Israel struck Iran Feb 28 2026

headline: Anthropic IPO filing: Nasdaq listing as ANT, soaring revenues, massive net losses disclosed
summary: Anthropic publicly filed its S-1 registration statement seeking a Nasdaq listing under the ticker ANT, disclosing soaring AI revenues alongside massive net losses.
